class Solution:
    def countPartitions(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        mod = 10**9 + 7
        sl = SortedList()
        n = len(nums)
        f = [1] + [0] * n
        g = [1] + [0] * n
        l = 1
        for r, x in enumerate(nums, 1):
            sl.add(x)
            while sl[-1] - sl[0] > k:
                sl.remove(nums[l - 1])
                l += 1
            f[r] = (g[r - 1] - (g[l - 2] if l >= 2 else 0) + mod) % mod
            g[r] = (g[r - 1] + f[r]) % mod
        return f[n]
